name: gdn_mega_bwd_cached_v8
description: PTO-ISA cached backward: resident Cube operands, fused UB epilogues/output assembly, state prefetch and direct transposed inverse completion.
timing: Synchronized wall time. Backward consumes buffers from forward and includes allocation/enqueue; forward execution is excluded. Forward denominator is forward_cache_ms with cache writes and preallocated buffers.
validation: 122 passed in 276.73s: 112 NPU and 10 CPU reference checks. Unchanged per-gradient max error <= 2 * reordered Torch error + 1e-5; allocation-only guard, input/cache integrity, streams, cancellation and fused packed/shared-head cases.
paired_method: Same process and identical inputs/caches; alternating old/new order, three warmup pairs and eleven measured pairs. Synchronized wall including backward allocation/enqueue, excluding forward.
baseline: gdn_mega_bwd_cached_v7.json; compiled device b54cbc2527d02828 (not v6 and not recomputation)
limits: 8K/Hv16/Hqk2 has 4.780 ms summed device kernel time in a warmed trace, but paired end-to-end median is 5.116 ms; the general 2x-forward goal is unmet.
Workspace and forward code/cache contracts are unchanged. Model autograd integration remains separate.
Heatmap measures 60 supported cached configurations; 20 unsupported forward cache producers remain N/A.
Profiler traffic includes L2 hits. Active-cycle ratios are not peak FLOP utilization.
HF32 was rejected after failing the fixed repeated-key dQ bound; retained products use FP32 Cube arithmetic.

profiling.method: msprof op --aic-metrics=Roofline; 8192 tokens, Hv64/Hqk16, both forward caches

h16_hk2_8192_trace.method: One warmed Torch NPU hardware trace; sum of three device kernel durations, excludes host allocation/enqueue and inter-launch gaps.
